Which type of company fits you?

This is the first question and it decides everything after it. Here is the short version.

  • LLC on the mainland. The usual choice if you want to sell to customers anywhere in Qatar. Read: LLC in Qatar
  • Free zone company. Good for export, storage and some service businesses, with limits on selling inside Qatar. Read: Free zone section
  • Qatar Financial Centre (QFC). For financial, professional and some corporate services. Read: QFC section
  • Representative office. For a foreign company that wants to explore the market, not sell. Read: Representative office section

Not sure? Send us two lines about your business and we will tell you which one fits.

Can a foreigner own 100 percent of a company in Qatar?

In most sectors, yes. Since Law No. 1 of 2019, foreign investors can hold full ownership of a company with approval from the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. A few sectors, such as banking and insurance, have their own rules. We explain how it works and what the ministry looks at.

100 percent foreign ownership in Qatar

Why start a company in Qatar

Short block, four facts, each one line. No link needed in the 13 page version.

  • No personal income tax on salaries.
  • A flat 10 percent corporate tax on taxable profit under the general regime.
  • Most services for starting a company are online through Single Window.
  • A steady flow of projects, from construction to retail to services.

[CONFIRM: client to approve these four lines]

Q: How long does it take to set up a company in Qatar?

For a standard mainland LLC with all documents ready, it often takes a few weeks from trade name to licence. Delays usually come from missing attestations or activity approvals. We give you a realistic range after we hear your business details. [CONFIRM: typical range the client is comfortable with]

Q: Do I need to be in Qatar to start a company?

Not for every step. Many steps are online and some can be done by power of attorney. You will need to sign the incorporation papers, either in person, digitally through Single Window or through an authorised signatory. We tell you which applies to you.

Q: What does your fee include?

We give you a written quote that separates our fee from government fees. [CONFIRM: what is included, such as trade name, CR, licence, establishment card, tax card]

Q: Do you work with people outside Qatar?

Yes. Many of our clients start the process from abroad. We work through email and WhatsApp and share documents by scan first.

Q: Can you take care of renewals later?

Yes. We keep your renewal dates and start the paperwork before they run out.
